unit_cn: Unit 5 Languages Around the World 世界语言
source: 人教版2019必修一 Unit 5 词表(p123 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、语言/汉字书写主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The Chinese writing system has lasted thousands of years.
words.example_cn: 汉字书写系统已延续数千年。

words.meaning_cn: 文字;符号;角色;品质;特点
words.example_en: Some ancient symbols can still be seen in today's characters.
words.example_cn: 一些古老的符号至今仍能在汉字中看到。

words.example_en: Chinese calligraphy is an important part of the culture.
words.example_cn: 中国书法是文化的重要组成部分。

words.example_en: China is known for its ancient civilisation.
words.example_cn: 中国以其古老的文明而闻名。

words.example_en: The writing system developed during the Shang Dynasty.
words.example_cn: 书写系统在商朝得到发展。

words.example_en: Ancient people carved symbols onto bones and shells.
words.example_cn: 古人把符号刻在骨头和龟甲上。

words.example_en: The symbols were carved by ancient Chinese people.
words.example_cn: 这些符号是古代中国人刻上去的。

words.example_en: Early writing was done on animal bones.
words.example_cn: 早期文字写在动物骨头上。

words.example_en: Symbols were carved onto bones and shells.
words.example_cn: 符号被刻在骨头和龟甲上。

words.example_en: People who speak different dialects can still read the same characters.
words.example_cn: 说不同方言的人仍能读懂同样的汉字。

words.example_en: Writing is a means by which the past connects with the present.
words.example_cn: 文字是连接过去与现在的一种方式。

words.meaning_cn: 经典的;典型的;经典作品
words.example_en: People today can read the classic works of the past.
words.example_cn: 今天的人能读懂过去的经典作品。

words.example_en: Chinese people hold their writing system in high regard.
words.example_cn: 中国人非常看重自己的书写系统。

words.example_en: Emperor Qinshihuang unified the writing system.
words.example_cn: 秦始皇统一了文字。

words.example_en: Over time, many varieties of characters appeared.
words.example_cn: 随着时间推移,出现了许多文字变体。

words.example_en: The writing system was a major factor in uniting the people.
words.example_cn: 书写系统是团结人民的一个主要因素。

words.example_en: Many factors helped the culture survive.
words.example_cn: 许多因素帮助这一文化得以延续。

words.example_en: The civilisation continued despite many ups and downs.
words.example_cn: 尽管历经诸多起伏,这一文明仍延续下来。

words.example_en: The symbols developed into a writing system.
words.example_cn: 这些符号发展成了一套书写系统。

words.example_en: The ancient civilisation has continued into modern times.
words.example_cn: 这一古老文明一直延续到现代。

words.example_en: People in modern times can read ancient writing.
words.example_cn: 现代人能读懂古代的文字。

words.example_en: People across China can communicate in writing.
words.example_cn: 中国各地的人都能用文字交流。

words.meaning_cn: 本地的;出生地的;本地人
words.example_en: Chinese has the most native speakers in the world.
words.example_cn: 汉语是世界上母语使用者最多的语言。

words.example_en: China plays a greater role in global affairs today.
words.example_cn: 如今中国在全球事务中发挥着更大作用。

words.example_en: These languages are spoken by billions of people.
words.example_cn: 这些语言被数十亿人使用。

words.example_en: My attitude towards language learning changed over time.
words.example_cn: 我对语言学习的态度逐渐改变了。

words.example_en: At first, studying German was a real struggle for me.
words.example_cn: 起初,学德语对我来说很吃力。

words.example_en: The new words felt strange on my tongue.
words.example_cn: 这些新词读起来很别扭。

words.example_en: Students begin to appreciate China's culture through the language.
words.example_cn: 学生们通过这门语言开始欣赏中国文化。

words.example_en: Scan the text to find specific information such as dates.
words.example_cn: 略读课文,寻找日期等具体信息。

words.example_en: Pronouns refer to something mentioned earlier in the text.
words.example_cn: 代词指代文中前面提到的事物。

words.example_en: Each sentence should relate to the main idea.
words.example_cn: 每个句子都应与中心思想相关。

words.example_en: A few kind words can bridge the gap between strangers.
words.example_cn: 几句友善的话能拉近陌生人之间的距离。

words.example_en: An increasing number of students are learning Chinese.
words.example_cn: 越来越多的学生在学习汉语。

words.example_en: English words are spelt according to how they sound.
words.example_cn: 英语单词按发音拼写。

words.example_en: Wang Le asked the forum for advice on listening.
words.example_cn: 王乐在论坛上请教听力方面的建议。

words.example_en: It is hard to know how to be polite in another language.
words.example_cn: 在另一种语言里很难掌握如何表达礼貌。

words.example_en: "Could you open the window?" is a polite request.
words.example_cn: "你能开下窗户吗?"是一个礼貌的请求。

words.example_en: How polite to be depends on who you are talking to.
words.example_cn: 该多礼貌取决于你在和谁说话。

words.example_en: Sometimes I record my voice to compare my pronunciation.
words.example_cn: 有时我录下自己的声音来比较发音。

words.example_en: I'm having a lot of trouble with my listening.
words.example_cn: 我的听力遇到了很多困难。

words.example_en: There are many reasons why people learn a foreign language.
words.example_cn: 人们学外语有许多原因。

words.example_en: The civilisation continued despite the ups and downs in its history.
words.example_cn: 尽管历史几经起伏,这一文明仍延续下来。

words.example_en: Written Chinese connects the present with the past.
words.example_cn: 汉字把现在与过去连接起来。
